claims.summary: Imported (Impagliazzo, Pudlak, Sgall, Lower Bounds for the Polynomial Calculus and the Groebner Basis Algorithm, ECCC TR97-042, Lemma 3.1, Lemma 5.1 from Clegg-Edmonds-Impagliazzo, Theorems 5.2 and 5.6, Corollary 5.7): PC lines are polynomials with Boolean axioms for all variables, degree the largest line degree. Lemma 3.1: a derivation whose monomials have at most b distinct variables yields one of degree max(b+1,d). Lemma 5.1: P of degree <=d with P|x=0 refuted in degree d and P|x=1 in degree d+1 is refuted in degree d+1. Theorem 5.2: degree-<=d axioms in n variables refuted with M monomials have a refutation of degree O(d+(n log M)^(1/2)); its proof gives <= 1+b+(n ln M)^(1/2), b=max(d,ceil((n ln M)^(1/2))). Theorem 5.6: functional PHP^m_n refuted with M monomials has a refutation of degree O((n log M)^(1/2)), counting a monomial's distinct holes; Corollary 5.7: 2^Omega(n) monomials over any field.
claims.assessment: Imported; Definitions 1.1 and 1.2, Lemma 3.1 with proof, Section 5 with the proofs of Theorems 5.2 and 5.6 read from the report's pages rendered as images (its text does not extract); the reviewer compared the statements with the page images.

claims.summary: Extended pigeonhole tradeoff: over any field, functional PHP^m_n (m>n) with Boolean axioms on all variables plus M acyclic extension axioms z_l-Q_l, z_l^2-z_l, Q_l of degree <=k in the x's and earlier z's and 0/1-valued on Boolean points, with composed degree K = max deg phi(z_l), phi substituting definitions, 1<=K<=n/4: if Gamma=(n/2+1)/K-max(k,2)-3>0, every PC refutation of size s has ln s >= Gamma^2/(8(n+M)). Proof: the substitution phi gives degree >= (n/2+1)/K (Razborov's n/2+1 bound); Theorem 5.6's induction of imp:ips-size-degree-tradeoff with holes and extension variables as items gives degree <= 3+max(k,2)+2(2(n+M) ln s)^(1/2). No hole cost; over F_2 nested parities of any fan-in have K=1. Vacuous once M is of order n^2/(32K^2), at most about N/(32K^2) on ordinary PHP.
claims.assessment: Working proof extending Theorem 5.6 of imp:ips-size-degree-tradeoff by extension variables as items and composed degree in the substitution; novelty in the literature not assessed. Reviewed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, whose corrections and general form (acyclic definitions, composed degree) are adopted.
claims.rationale: Supersedes what the hole-cost restriction's statements on ordinary PHP implied, and moves the cleanup's inventory cap.
claims.next_action: None at the goal's inventories, which exceed the cap; definitions with unbounded-fan-in OR or AND gates can exceed K <= n/4.
